description: Replaces the files of a slug owned by the token, or, when merge is true, adds and overwrites only the paths sent. Inputs: slug, files, and optional spa, merge, expected_version, via, token, listed, category, tags, title, and description. Returns url, path_url, slug, listing, and a new version. When expected_version does not match the live version, the result is version_conflict and nothing is written. Two racing updates return version_conflict even without expected_version. listed defaults to false. Password-protected sites cannot be listed. A new version of a listed slug runs the gallery checks again.

category.description: Gallery category. Required when listed is true.

description.description: Gallery description, at most 300 characters. Required when listed is true.

expected_version.description: Live version this update is based on, such as "v3". If the site has moved on, the call returns version_conflict with no write. Omit it and a concurrent update still returns version_conflict rather than dropping files.

files.description:
Path map, or an array of {path, content} or {path, base64}. Paths are stored exactly as given (a single top-level directory is not removed). Text as a string, binary as {"base64":"..."}. Example: {"index.html":"

Hi

","img/logo.png":{"base64":"iVBOR..."}}. Any other array is rejected.

listed.description: Opt into the public gallery. Default false. false removes the slug immediately. Password-protected sites cannot be listed.

merge.description: Keep every path you do not send, and add or overwrite only these exact paths.

slug.description: Slug you own. Must match ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$. Not rewritten. Reserved slugs are rejected.

tags.description: Up to 5 tags. Each tag is lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, at most 32 characters.

title.description: Gallery title, at most 80 characters. Required when listed is true.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

via.description: Optional label stored with the publish. At most 80 characters. An IP address, a URL, or an email address is not stored. A non-empty value replaces the X-Via header.

name: update_site
title: Update a site
